'''Macroscan''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

Title

望遠スキャン

Card Text

２フォース消費して、相手のリザーブデッキのそばに配備する。１フォース消費して、好きなときにそのデッキの一番上のカードを見ることができる。場のどこかに“夜間状態”になっているカードがあれば、１枚ではなく上から３枚のカードを見ることができる。

Lore

''電子双眼鏡の映像。目標の方位、高さ、距離が正確に表示される。暗視機能を内蔵する。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Long-range scan. '''Card text:''' Spend 2 Force to deploy beside the opponent's Reserve Deck. You may spend 1 Force at any time to look at the top card of that deck. If a card anywhere on the table is in ‘nighttime conditions,’ you may look at the top three cards instead of one. '''Lore:''' An electrobinocular image. The target's direction, height and distance are displayed accurately. It has built-in night vision. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to a card on the table being in nighttime conditions; the English says nighttime conditions exist anywhere on the table. The Japanese lore describes the displayed direction, height and distance; the English specifies true and relative azimuth, elevation and range.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Macroscan]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/star-wars-ccg-japanese-premiere/imagegallery/29544 Japanese Premiere collector image gallery], PSA.

Title

キンタン・ストライダー

Card Text

相手のキャラクターが没収されたか、ロストした直後に使う。１フォース消費して自分のキャラクターの１名を復活させる。ロストデッキの中からもっとも上にあるキャラクターを１人、手札に戻すこと。

Lore

''デジャリックのホログラムに登場する獰猛な生物で、驚異的な治癒能力を持っている。故郷のキンタンでは絶滅しているが、ハット人のギャングたちが護衛に使用している。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Kintan Strider. '''Card text:''' Use immediately after an opponent's character is forfeited or lost. Spend 1 Force to revive one of your characters: return the character closest to the top of the Lost Pile to your hand. '''Lore:''' A ferocious creature appearing in a dejarik hologram, with remarkable healing abilities. Extinct on its homeworld of Kintan, it is used for protection by Hutt gangsters. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says to revive a character and return the topmost character from the Lost Pile to hand; the English uses the term regenerate and specifies retrieving the character closest to the top of your Lost Pile.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Kintan Strider]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/star-wars-ccg-japanese-premiere/imagegallery/29544 Japanese Premiere collector image gallery], PSA.

Title

女予言者

Card Text

女預言者のいる場所で戦闘を宣言した場合、戦闘を開始する前に、どちらが勝つかを予測して相手に告げる（必ず行うこと）。戦闘の結果が予測どおりなら、君はロストしたカードを無作為に１枚、再使用できる。予測がはずれたなら、１フォースを失う。耐：損耗＜３。

Lore

''名高い超能力者。凶運を察知する女性。タトゥイーンの統治者アリオンの使者。ハン・ソロに会うため、ドッキング・ベイ94に向かったジャバと手下どもの後をつけた。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Prophetess. '''Card text:''' If you declare a battle where the Prophetess is, predict which side will win and tell the opponent before the battle starts; you must do this. If the outcome matches your prediction, you may randomly reuse one lost card. If the prediction is wrong, lose 1 Force. Immune to attrition < 3. '''Lore:''' A renowned psychic who senses ill fortune, and an agent of Aryon, ruler of Tatooine. She followed Jabba and his subordinates to Docking Bay 94, where they went to meet Han Solo. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says to tell the opponent the prediction and that a randomly selected lost card may be reused. The English requires a prediction and says to randomly retrieve one lost card. The Japanese lore says Jabba's party went to meet Han; the English says they confronted him.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Prophetess]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/star-wars-ccg-japanese-premiere/imagegallery/29544 Japanese Premiere collector image gallery], PSA.

Title

タッグ将軍

Card Text

同じ位置に帝国軍トルーパー（どのタイプでもよい）が１名いるごとに、タッグの没収値が＋１される。

Lore

''デス・スターの防衛任務を統括する傑出した戦術家。堅実なリーダー。有力な貴族階級かつ宇宙兵器コングロマリットを運営するタッグ家の一員。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' General Tagge. '''Card text:''' Tagge's forfeit is increased by 1 for each Imperial trooper of any type at the same location. '''Lore:''' An outstanding tactician who oversees the Death Star's defense operations. A steady leader. A member of the powerful noble House of Tagge, which operates a space-weapons conglomerate. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese game text refers to troopers at the same location; the English specifies troopers present with Tagge at a site. The Japanese lore describes a space-weapons conglomerate, while the English says a corporate conglomerate.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[General Tagge]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Title

カーベ

Card Text

自分の支配フェイズに、同じ位置にいる相手の武器かアイテムを対象に選ぶ。運命数を引き、運命数＜対象の運命数ならば、盗んだことになる。アイテムならそのまま使え、武器ならば同じ位置にいる戦士に渡す（コスト０で配備する）ことができる。

Lore

''チャドラ・ファンの少女盗賊。マフタックが保護者。奴隷商人にタトゥイーンに捨てられた。ジュリ・ジュースが好物。モス・アイズリーのジャバ・ザ・ハットの別宅を荒らす。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Kabe. '''Card text:''' During your control phase, choose an opponent's weapon or item at the same location as a target. Draw destiny; if it is less than the target's destiny number, it is stolen. An item can be used as it is; a weapon can be handed to a warrior at the same location, deploying it at zero cost. '''Lore:''' A young Chadra-Fan thief whose guardian is Muftak. Abandoned on Tatooine by slavers. Fond of juri juice. Robs Jabba the Hutt's residence in Mos Eisley. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to an opponent's weapon or item at the same location; the English names a weapon or device at the same site. The Japanese lore says Kabe robs Jabba's residence; the English says she once robbed it.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Kabe]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/star-wars-ccg-japanese-premiere/imagegallery/29544 Japanese Premiere collector image gallery], PSA.

Title

地元のいざこざ

Card Text

自分の戦闘フェイズの最初に１フォース消費して使う。カンティーナにいるストームトルーパーを２名選び、相手のキャラクターを１名選んで戦闘させられる。戦闘運命数を１回引くことができる。そのターンには、カンティーナでは他の戦闘は起こらない。

Lore

''「どうやらさっきのあんたの腕前に気をひかれた奴がいるようだぜ」帝国軍のストームトルーパーは、地元の住民に反乱分子逮捕への協力を強要する。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Local trouble. '''Card text:''' Spend 1 Force to use at the beginning of your battle phase. Choose two Stormtroopers in the Cantina and one opposing character and make them battle. You may draw one battle destiny. No other battles occur in the Cantina that turn. '''Lore:''' ‘It looks like someone has taken an interest in your handiwork just now.’ Imperial Stormtroopers compel local residents to help arrest Rebel elements. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says you may draw battle destiny once; the English says you may add one battle destiny. Both refer to choosing two Stormtroopers in the Cantina and one opposing character.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Local Trouble]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/star-wars-ccg-japanese-premiere/imagegallery/29544 Japanese Premiere collector image gallery], PSA.
